hypotheses.name: Dual-filtration local witness persistence
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung with seeds 42/43/44, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {7,11}, computed edge-local cycle surrogates under joint geodesic-distance and support-margin filtrations, added to H70 baseline, and evaluated against matched-random hotspot, feature-shuffle, and label-permutation nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.00360; positive mean domain-splits=5/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=3/6
hypotheses.next_action: Run one targeted repair pass on failing domain-splits with calibrated local neighborhoods; keep only if null-gap-positive means reach >=4/6.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model barcode OT depth alignment
hypotheses.method: Seed42 pilot on immune/lung/external_lung with scGPT layers {0,3,7,11} and Geneformer token-rank quartile strata; built TRRUST+GO module distance barcodes per depth, solved OT alignment, and tested against random-transport, depth-order permutation, and barcode-component permutation nulls.
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this cross-model formulation; reopen only with a materially changed topology-level anchor and explicit domain matching constraints.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Null-gap remained negative in all pilot domains (0/3).

hypotheses.name: Sparse descriptor blend breadth screen
hypotheses.method: Seed42 breadth screen across immune/lung/external_lung, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {0,3,7,11}; fit cross-validated sparse logistic blend over geodesic/topology descriptors on top of H70 baseline and tested descriptor-shuffle, endpoint-swap, and label-permutation nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.08035; positive rows=24/24; positive mean domain-splits=6/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=4/6
hypotheses.next_action: Promote to multiseed robustness validation with increased null resolution and pre-registered split-level gate.
